worker_workflow: 2. Đọc architecture.md để biết chuẩn tuân thủ
3. Đọc tasks.json, tìm task có status=pending được giao cho mình
4. Thực thi task (CHỈ sửa file liên quan, tối ưu token)
5. Cập nhật tasks.json: status→done, thêm completedAt + notes
6. Nếu task phức tạp: ghi report vào reports/{task_id}.md
7. Chạy build verify: dotnet build gtas_vpp/gtas_vpp.slnx

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.description: Dọn dẹp template files, fix typo, di chuyển DTO. KHÔNG thay đổi logic.

tasks.description: Xóa template files không dùng
Fix typo: BussinessService → BusinessService (class, interface, file, DI, all references)
Di chuyển inline DTOs (CopyPreviousMonthReqDTO, RejectOrderReqDTO) từ cuối VPPRequestController.cs ra gtas_vpp_shared/DTOs/Req/VPP/
Xóa [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Auto)] + using System.Runtime.InteropServices khỏi UnitOfWork.cs và VPPMigrationDbContext.cs
Xóa [Inject] attribute trên BaseServices._unitOfWorkFactory (line 27), đổi thành private readonly. Xóa using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
Xóa csproj exclude rules cho Counter.razor, Weather.razor trong gtas_vpp_fe.csproj (các dòng Compile Remove và Content Remove)

phases.name: Service Layer Refactor
phases.description: Tách God Class BaseServices, refactor UnitOfWork, loại bỏ BusinessService wrapper
phases.prerequisite: P1 hoàn thành + bổ sung unit tests

tasks.description: Viết unit tests cho BaseServices CRUD (AddAsync, UpdateAsync, DeleteAsync, ReadAsync, SP, Query) để có safety net trước khi tách
tasks.notes: Added BaseServices environment/CRUD tests and VPPRequestService business-rule tests. dotnet test code-be/gtas_vpp_be.Tests/ passed 17/17. dotnet build gtas_vpp/gtas_vpp.slnx passed with existing Mapster nullable warnings.

tasks.description: Tách GetEnvironment() từ BaseServices + UnitOfWork thành IEnvironmentResolver/EnvironmentResolver. Xóa duplicate. Single source of truth.
tasks.notes: Extracted IEnvironmentResolver/EnvironmentResolver, wired BaseServices/UnitOfWork/UnitOfWorkFactory and DI. Build passed after task.

tasks.description: Tách WithUserNames + SetUserNameIfExists + IncludeUserInfoIfNeeded thành IUserNameResolver. Thay reflection bằng generic constraint hoặc cache PropertyInfo.
tasks.notes: Extracted IUserNameResolver/UserNameResolver with cached reflection and moved username enrichment out of BaseServices. Build passed after task.

tasks.description: Tách CRUD (AddAsync, UpdateAsync, DeleteAsync, ReadAsync, GetByIdAsync) thành IGenericRepository<T>. Xóa string-based context switching.
tasks.notes: Added IGenericRepository/GenericRepository, moved CRUD out of BaseServices, registered open generic repository, updated CRUD tests. Build passed after task.

tasks.description: Tách SP() + Query() thành IStoredProcedureExecutor. Giữ FromSqlRaw pattern nhưng tách riêng class.
tasks.notes: Added IStoredProcedureExecutor/StoredProcedureExecutor and removed SP/Query from BaseServices. Build passed after task.

tasks.description: UnitOfWork: bỏ TransactionScope, dùng DbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(). Inject IEnvironmentResolver thay vì tự resolve.
tasks.notes: Replaced TransactionScope with EF Core IDbContextTransaction while keeping IUnitOfWork method signatures. Build passed after task.

tasks.description: Loại bỏ BusinessService wrapper. Thay tất cả _bussinessService.BaseService<T>() calls trong controllers bằng inject trực tiếp IGenericRepository + IStoredProcedureExecutor.
tasks.notes: Removed BusinessService/IBusinessService and DI registration. Controllers now use IGenericRepository, IStoredProcedureExecutor, IUserNameResolver, or direct UnitOfWork where relation queries already existed. AuthController was also updated because it referenced BusinessService. Build passed after task.

tasks.description: Merge GetMyOrdersAsync + GetMyOrdersSummaryAsync thành 1 private method trong VPPRequestService (code gần giống hệt nhau)
tasks.notes: Added shared GetFilteredOrdersAsync and kept both public interface methods for API compatibility. Build passed after task.

phases.name: Cross-cutting Concerns
phases.description: Error handling, logging, Jira config extraction

tasks.description: Tạo ExceptionHandlingMiddleware trả ProblemDetails (RFC 7807). Map KeyNotFoundException→404, UnauthorizedAccessException→403, InvalidOperationException→400.
tasks.notes: Created ExceptionHandlingMiddleware with ProblemDetails mapping and registered it before authentication. Build passed after task.

tasks.description: Enable Serilog trên BE project (hiện chỉ FE có, và đã comment out). Cấu hình trong Program.cs.
tasks.notes: Added Serilog.AspNetCore, Console, and File sinks to BE and configured Program.cs. FE logging comments unchanged. Build passed after task.

tasks.description: Implement BaseServices.WriteLog() — hiện method rỗng. Inject ILogger<T>, ghi structured log.
tasks.notes: Injected ILogger<BaseServices>, implemented structured WriteLog, and updated VPPRequestService/test construction. Build passed after task.

tasks.description: Tách JiraIssueLive/JiraIssueTest config từ BaseServices thành IOptions<JiraSettings>. Giữ code, chỉ refactor cấu trúc (chưa dùng nhưng sẽ dùng).
tasks.notes: Added JiraSettings, registered options binding, removed JiraIssueLive/JiraIssueTest/DeployEnv config classes, and updated BaseServices. Build passed after task.

phases.name: Frontend Cleanup
phases.description: Dọn FE Program.cs, xóa template leftovers

tasks.description: Di chuyển inline /perform-login MapGet (40+ dòng) từ FE Program.cs ra LoginEndpoints.cs (Minimal API extension method)
tasks.notes: Moved /perform-login MapGet into LoginEndpoints extension without changing login logic. Build passed after task.

phases.name: Security Fixes + Cleanup
phases.description: Fix SQL injection risk, restrict CORS, harden cookies, clean commented FE code, and add controller/middleware tests.

tasks.description: Fix SQL Injection trong StoredProcedureExecutor.ExecuteQueryAsync bằng parameterized FromSqlRaw overload và cập nhật call site SQLController.
tasks.notes: ExecuteQueryAsync now requires params object?[] and SQLController.Query accepts a parameterized payload instead of raw body string.

tasks.description: Fix CORS policy: load AllowedOrigins from appsettings and replace AllowAll with AllowFrontend.
tasks.notes: Removed AllowAnyOrigin and configured WithOrigins(...).AllowCredentials() from CorsSettings.

tasks.description: Fix cookie security on FE.
tasks.notes: Set HttpOnly, SameSite=None, and SecurePolicy=Always for auth cookie.

tasks.description: Xóa commented-out code cũ trong FE Components, giữ comments giải thích logic.
tasks.notes: Removed stale BusinessService/BaseService/SPServiceRead/ContinueWith comment blocks; scan confirms no leftover commented anti-patterns in .razor.cs Components.

tasks.description: Viết tests cho ExceptionHandlingMiddleware, VPPRequestController, AuthController.
tasks.notes: Added 10 controller/middleware tests. dotnet test code-be/gtas_vpp_be.Tests/ passed 27/27. dotnet build gtas_vpp/gtas_vpp.slnx passed.

phases.name: Final Fixes
phases.description: Remove raw SQL endpoint, clear obsolete crypto warnings, and verify nullable/Mapster warning cleanup.

tasks.description: Loại bỏ SQLController.Query endpoint và xác minh FE không gọi api/SQL/Query; đánh giá whitelist cho api/SQL/{spName}.
tasks.notes: Verified SQLController has no Query action, FE has no api/SQL/Query usage, IStoredProcedureExecutor has no ExecuteQueryAsync surface, and StoreProcedure rejects spName values outside AllowedStoredProcedures.

tasks.description: Thay obsolete MD5CryptoServiceProvider/TripleDESCryptoServiceProvider bằng MD5.Create()/TripleDES.Create() trong PasswordHelpers.cs.
tasks.notes: Verified PasswordHelpers uses MD5.Create() and TripleDES.Create(); solution build passed with 0 SYSLIB0021 warnings.

tasks.description: Fix nullable CS8618 warnings in Model entities and Mapster nullability warnings.
tasks.notes: Verified dotnet build gtas_vpp/gtas_vpp.slnx passes with 0 warnings, including no CS8618 or Mapster nullable warnings.

phases.name: Final Polish
phases.description: Fix Blazor event subscription cleanup and remove hardcoded JWT key fallback.

tasks.description: Implement IDisposable for Component_Library and unsubscribe NavigationManager.LocationChanged; scan other .razor.cs event subscriptions.
tasks.notes: Component_Library now implements IDisposable and unsubscribes NavigationManager.LocationChanged. Other .razor.cs event subscribers already had unsubscribe handling.

tasks.description: Remove hardcoded JWT key fallback and require JwtSettings:Key configuration at startup.
tasks.notes: JwtSettings:Key now throws InvalidOperationException when missing or blank, Program evaluates it during startup, AuthController no longer falls back to a hardcoded key, production appsettings has an empty Key, and development appsettings keeps the local dev key.
